statement: The transaction the Host sends is the EIP-1559 encoding of the call to processBatch, signed by the sender's key, byte for byte what an independent library produces for the same fields; a recipient or data that is not hex is a fault the submit path reads, never a throw.
source: e2e S2 (the Host's send); R-DURABLE (the batch is journaled sealed before it is sent)

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival specs do not take a chain transaction's bytes
layers.quint: n/a: the transaction's encoding is the chain client's, not a state-machine rule
layers.contract: n/a: the node validates the transaction; the contract sees only its calldata
layers.rig: owed: test rig (the e2e skeleton S2 sends one through anvil; no walk predicate names it)

killers.name: R-SUBMIT-TX the raw bytes of each signed transaction equal the other library's
R-SUBMIT-TX a recipient or data that is not hex is refused, naming the fault
